scenes.title: Pip Meets the Family
scenes.narration: Pip the little robot beeped with joy as he met the new family and their baby, Ellie.
scenes.image_prompt: A cute, small robot with a friendly face meeting a family with a baby in their living room.

scenes.title: The Search Begins
scenes.narration: Pip zoomed around the town, checking different daycares to find the perfect one for Ellie.
scenes.image_prompt: A small robot visiting colorful daycare centers, surrounded by children playing and laughing.

scenes.title: A Happy Choice
scenes.narration: Pip found a daycare full of smiles and fun, and Ellie giggled with delight when she arrived.
scenes.image_prompt: A happy baby being welcomed at a cheerful daycare with friendly staff and playful children.
